draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.15, the 104th-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 16th of 39 at LB. He lasted until pick 132, well after his grade rank (104th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Zach Cunningham. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 84 tackles in 2019, 14th of 39 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 7 pro, currently with the Los Angeles Chargers. 93 career games and 20 starts over 6 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 4 AV in 2025 against a career-best 4 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: tackles for loss 5 (79th percentile), passes defended 4 (78th percentile). Weak spots: missed tackle rate 13.4% (12th percentile). Versus the typical Year-6 off-ball linebacker who played: 58 combined tackles against a median of 64, below the norm.
